title: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG through a Chart-based Document Question-Answering Generation Framework
reasoning: The paper introduces the 'Chart-MRAG Bench', which includes 'Religion & Culture' as one of its eight primary evaluation domains, accounting for approximately 10% of the dataset. The benchmark specifically includes questions and data regarding religious identity (e.g., atheism in Europe) and religious practices (e.g., Japanese Obon rituals).
